# Zeabur OSS

> Zeabur is an open-source management interface for Kubernetes clusters. Its installer sets up K3s or RKE2, the components you choose, Zeabur Identity (passkey sign-in) and Zeabur on a Linux server. The pages below cover installing it.

Install on one Linux server (systemd, amd64 or arm64) with `zeabur-installer`. The installer opens a web interface, or reads `/etc/zeabur-installer/config.yaml` and runs `plan` and `apply`. Run `plan` and show the user its output before `apply`. The first administrator's registration link creates an admin account, so give it to the user and don't open it.

## Install

- [Install Zeabur on a single server](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/get-started/quickstart): Server requirements, the one-line command that opens the installer web interface, and each step of it.
- [Install with an AI Agent](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/get-started/ai-agent): Key sign-in over SSH and the prompt that has an AI agent install Zeabur with `plan` and `apply`, then hand over the registration link.
- [Install with a config file and commands](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/get-started/advanced-install): The config file, `plan` and `apply`.
- [Personal use: install on a small machine](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/get-started/personal): KubeSolo on a machine with 1.5 GiB of memory.
- [Install Zeabur in an existing cluster](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/get-started/install): Helm chart and Zeabur Identity client for a cluster you already have.

## Reference

- [Installer commands](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/reference/installer): `plan`, `apply`, `gui`, `doctor`, `node add` and the other `zeabur-installer` commands.
- [Installer configuration](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/reference/installer-configuration): YAML fields and defaults of `config.yaml`.
- [Release files and verification](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/reference/releases): Asset names, `SHA256SUMS`, signatures and build provenance. Verify before running a downloaded file.
- [zeaburctl](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur/reference/zeaburctl): Open Zeabur with a kubeconfig, check a cluster.

## Optional

- [Zeabur docs](https://oss.zeabur.com/docs/zeabur): All pages of the Zeabur docs.
- [Zeabur on GitHub](https://github.com/zeabur-oss/zeabur): Source code and releases.
